title: sulfur cube sulfur bomb
description: Adds a new archetype to Sulfur Cubes, sulfur bomb, they cause fire, have a 10 tick fuse and a level 2 explosion making them pretty different from regular explosive sulfur cubes, use them in pvp or to set traps, theres a lot you can do with them
body:
This Datapack includes a new archetype of sulfur cubes, Sulfur Bombs, by default set to use the sulfur block types, they are a new type of explosive with a much shorter fuse (10 ticks / 0.5 seconds) they cause fire and have a weaker explosion compared to regular explosive sulfur cubes, fun to use both in combat and in traps
